## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: extremely weak breadth (2/11) and large-cap tech & growth names are broadly BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, META, TSLA), supporting the risk-off read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%). Financials showing pockets of strength: WFC RECOVERY (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%), GS RECOVERY (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%), MS RECOVERY (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%). Technology shows isolated strength in semiconductors: LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%), AMAT RECOVERY (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Utilities weak: CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%), EXC BELOW TREND (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%), VST BELOW TREND (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -15.24%). Materials and Industrials also soft with major names BELOW TREND (FCX BELOW TREND, NEM BELOW TREND, BA BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%), WFC RECOVERY (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%), AMAT RECOVERY (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%), SLB RECOVERY (1W: +4.27% | 1M: -9.53%). Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 split across Energy, Tech, Financials — not broad).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%), ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -8.59%), SBUX BELOW TREND (1W: -6.66% | 1M: -3.39%), EXC BELOW TREND (1W: -6.78% | 1M: -1.10%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%). Weakness concentrated in Utilities, Healthcare and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: LRCX (1W: +7.62%), OXY (1W: +4.89%), WFC (1W: +4.72%), AMAT (1W: +4.55%), SLB (1W: +4.27%); note most are RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down) — major tactical divergence versus broad market weakness, so treat as short-term rallies.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech mixed with semiconductors rallying but mega-cap software/hardware under pressure: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.46% | 1M: -4.16%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%), AMAT RECOVERY (1W: +4.55% | 1M: -3.45%), LRCX RECOVERY (1W: +7.62% | 1M: -3.69%). Sector breadth: weak (majority of large-cap tech BELOW TREND).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are patchy but relatively resilient: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -6.98%), WFC RECOVERY (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -11.39%), GS RECOVERY (1W: +4.00% | 1M: -10.78%), MS RECOVERY (1W: +4.26% | 1M: -7.40%). Breadth: modestly positive within Financials, supporting defensive rotation into select banks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare soft overall with exceptions: JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -4.17%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -2.30% | 1M: -4.21%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.47% | 1M: +0.41%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%). Sector breadth: weak with headline defensive names failing to lead.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and selected Financials given clear relative strength; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech and cyclicals showing structural weakness. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy + Financial leadership, but remain cautious given narrow breadth and RECOVERY rallies in semis — monitor for trend confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%).  
BEARISH: NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -12.58% | 1M: -23.45%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%), BA BELOW TREND (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -16.51%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (sector 1W: +2.90% | momentum in large names).  
BEARISH: Utilities, Materials, Industrials (all weak on 1W and many constituents BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA 1W weakness — watch for failure to reclaim near-term resistance as sign of extended downside (NVDA BELOW TREND: 1W: -4.19% | 1M: -8.08%).  
AAPL support test risk: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -4.83%) — failure to hold recent supports would extend risk-off.  
OXY momentum breakout continuation to confirm Energy leadership: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) — watch for follow-through on volume.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
OXY (+60): Warren Buffett stake headline; price confirming (OXY ABOVE TREND, 1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%) — accumulation.  
LLY (+60): China commitment headline; price diverging (LLY BELOW TREND, 1W: -7.96% | 1M: -11.39%) — bullish news but selling, watch for distribution.  
EMR (+60): Guidance/buyback headline; price not in top detailed list here — monitor for follow-through if price moves align with positive news.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CEG (-50): JPMorgan cut headline; price confirming (CEG BELOW TREND, 1W: -6.55% | 1M: -3.19%).  
PYPL (-70): litigation/CEO risk headline; large negative sentiment — monitor for downside if price follows.  
ACN (-55)/QCOM (-50): negative analyst headlines on technology names — potential pressure on already weak tech cohort.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.  
Energy and select Financials showing relative strength — OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.89% | 1M: +18.37%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +13.74%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +5.76%).  
Key risk: major divergence — mega-cap Tech/Growth broadly BELOW TREND while short-term RECOVERY rallies in semiconductors create tactical noise; monitor LLY news vs price for sentiment-driven spillovers.
